quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Chi is a part of you.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: You are ready. I've never been more sure of anything.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: I'm not a big fat panda. I'm THE big fat panda.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: You gotta let go of that stuff from the past because it just doesn't matter. The only thing that matters is what you choose to be now.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: How can kung fu stop something that stops kung fu?
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: My time has come. You must now continue your journey without me. You must believe...
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: I too came from humble beginnings.
quotes.author: The Chameleon

quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: One often meets his destiny on the road he takes to avoid it.
quotes.author: Master Oogway
